reliefos-grub.reason: GNU GRUB 2.16 built from locked source for musl, its BIOS platform modules and GPL notices, and the shared ReliefOS boot installer CLI. Console tools have no desktop icons.

reliefos-xdm-config.reason: Local XDM policy at the upstream default paths. The signed package depends on and replaces the overlapping configuration files of xdm, without modifying the upstream archive.

reliefos-nls.reason: Message catalogs from configs/nls/po, scoped per language to preserve upstream catalog ownership.

reliefos-apps.reason: Native desktop, service, graphics and application interfaces. Embedded dependencies remain part of their actual consumers.

reliefos-reliefplayer.reason: ReliefPlayer audio executable, launcher, desktop entry and component artwork are installed and removed together. minimp3 remains embedded in its consumers.

reliefos-reliefcapture.reason: ReliefCapture screenshot and annotation executable, launcher, desktop entry and component artwork are installed and removed together.

reliefos-reliefdiagram.reason: ReliefDiagram editor, desktop entry, MIME declaration and component artwork are installed and removed together.

reliefos-reliefmathpp.reason: ReliefMath++ geometry application, desktop entry, MIME declaration and component artwork are installed and removed together.

reliefos-relieftodo.reason: ReliefTodo task manager, desktop launcher, MIME declaration and component artwork are installed and removed together.

reliefos-reliefmath.reason: ReliefMath GUI and isolated worker, their private math font and license texts, desktop launcher, MIME declaration and component icon are installed and removed together.

reliefos-fastfetch.reason: Retain the verified ReliefOS release with the legacy LeonOS Logo alias. The future real local APK must depend on !fastfetch. This manifest does not enforce that conflict.

musl.reason: Password-file locking patch and loader ABI require validation before replacing the running system libc. No fabricated musl provides.

reliefos-mimalloc.reason: ReliefOS runtime allocator contract; statically linked copies belong to their consumers.

reliefos-musl-dev.reason: Default-installed headers, startup objects and static libraries generated from the exact runtime musl sysroot. The APK builder assigns their exact file paths when packaging and repackaging roots.

busybox.reason: Transfer /bin/sh and applet symlinks together after shell, init and installer regressions. Separately installed utilities retain their own paths.

findutils.reason: Use the official Alpine findutils implementation for find and xargs; do not duplicate these commands in BusyBox.

coreutils.reason: Ship GNU dd only: this BusyBox has no dd applet and its dd lacks status=progress. Do not duplicate the remaining coreutils commands against BusyBox applets.

authentication.reason: PAM patches and pam_leonos_password need real local packaging; preserve policy, setuid modes and login semantics before any upstream replacement.

auth-support-libraries.reason: Upstream dependencies of shadow; transfer headers, libraries and metadata with authentication consumers.

storage-util-linux.reason: Includes split libraries and command packages; resolve actual repository file ownership before choosing subpackages. Installer relies on these tools.

storage-filesystems.reason: Transfer formatter/checker aliases with commands; preserve ext2 installer behavior.

ncurses.reason: Resolve terminal data/tools split and libraries from repository metadata; preserve leonos TERM support.

ca-certificates-bundle.reason: The actual CA bundle is packaged separately so curl dependencies and authenticated upstream updates can own it.

sqlite.reason: Current custom SONAME and native consumers need migration before upstream library replacement.

trust.reason: Transfer trust data via authenticated packages; validate certificate update triggers on ReliefOS.

reliefos-apk-tools.reason: Upstream apk transaction tools plus the local signed repository updater and legacy command paths.

reliefos-base.reason: Fallback distribution inventory, not proof of an individual package producer. Includes kernel, boot, identity and layout; review every fallback before generating APKs.
